title: Sharp Stationary Gaussian Approximation for Constant-Stepsize SGD
abstract: arXiv:2609.39144v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We prove a sharp Gaussian approximation for the invariant law of constant-stepsize SGD with bounded additive noise generated by an exogenous uniformly ergodic Markov chain. For a smooth, strongly convex objective with a Lipschitz Hessian and nondegenerate long-run noise covariance, the centered iterate normalized by the square root of the stepsize is $O(\sqrt{\alpha})$-close in 1-Wasserstein distance to its limiting Gaussian. The proof combines blockwise Gaussian comparison with long-run contraction. A four-state example gives a matching lower bound although the one-time noise marginal is symmetric and every nonzero-lag autocovariance vanishes. In this example, an adjacent third-order mixed moment produces the leading correction.

translated_title: 常数步长SGD的精确平稳高斯逼近
translated_abstract: 我们针对常数步长SGD的不变分布证明了一个精确的高斯逼近，其中加性噪声有界且由外生的一致遍历马尔可夫链生成。对于具有Lipschitz Hessian矩阵和非退化长期噪声协方差的光滑强凸目标函数，以步长平方根归一化的中心化迭代点在1-Wasserstein距离下与其极限高斯分布的偏差为 $O(\sqrt{\alpha})$。证明方法结合了分块高斯比较与长期收缩技术。一个四状态例子给出了匹配的下界，尽管该例子中单时点噪声的边缘分布是对称的，且所有非零滞后的自协方差均为零。在此例子中，相邻的三阶混合矩产生了主要的修正项。
tldr: 该论文证明了常数步长SGD平稳分布的精确高斯逼近——归一化迭代点在1-Wasserstein距离下以 $O(\sqrt{\alpha})$ 速率收敛于极限高斯分布，并通过四状态例子给出匹配下界，揭示即使噪声对称且时间上不相关，三阶混合矩仍是主导修正来源。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a sharp Gaussian approximation for the stationary law of constant-stepsize SGD, showing the normalized iterate is $O(\sqrt{\alpha})$-close in 1-Wasserstein distance to its limiting Gaussian, with a four-state example providing a matching lower bound that reveals third-order mixed moments drive the leading correction even under symmetric, time-uncorrelated noise.
